transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. What brings you here today? Is there something specific you’d like to talk about or get help with?
I guess... I’ve been having these thoughts that maybe it’d be easier if I just didn’t wake up. I haven’t made any plan to hurt myself or anything, but... yeah, that’s why I came in.
How often have you been having these thoughts, and when did they first start?
Pretty often, I guess. It kind of comes and goes, but I keep catching myself thinking that maybe it’d be easier if I just didn’t wake up. I’m not planning to do anything… it’s just been there lately.
How long have you been feeling this way? Has this been going on for at least two years, or is it something that started more recently?
No… not two years. More like the last three months or so, since I kind of crashed. It’s just been hanging around since then.
Have you noticed that you don’t enjoy things as much as you used to, or that you’ve lost interest in activities you once liked?
Yeah… I guess so. Stuff I used to do to unwind—fishing, going through my records, tailgating, checking on my home-brew—it all just feels like work now. I don’t really care about it like I did.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?
Yeah… most days. After that energy wore off, it was like I just… ran out. I’d sit there at the table with my coffee, not really doing anything, just feeling empty. Ashamed, I guess.
Have you been feeling a lack of energy or fatigue, like even small tasks take a lot of effort?
I don’t know… I mean, I get tired, sure, but I haven’t really been keeping track of it. Small stuff feels harder sometimes, I guess, but… yeah, I’m not sure.
Has there been a time recently where you felt no interest or pleasure in things you used to enjoy, not even a little bit?
Yeah… I mean, pretty much. I stopped caring about the stuff that usually helps me settle down—fishing, my records, tailgating, even checking on the home-brew. It all just felt like chores.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently—like eating a lot less or more than usual?
Yeah… I guess I’ve been eating less. Most days I kind of have to remind myself to eat, and supper just… looks like too much trouble. My jeans are a little looser too.
Have you been feeling like you’re not worth much or that you’re a failure, or have you been blaming yourself for things more than usual?
I don’t know… not really like that. I mean, I get down on myself some, like anybody, but I wouldn’t say I’ve been sitting around thinking I’m a failure or anything.
Have you been feeling guilty about things more than usual, or like you’re letting people down even when you aren’t?
No… I don’t think so. I mean, I worry I’m not doing enough sometimes, but I wouldn’t say I feel guilty like that.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or on the flip side, feeling restless or fidgety without being able to settle down?
I haven’t really noticed that, no. Maybe I’m a little slower some days, but… nothing that stands out to me.
Have you felt like you're not worth much or that you're letting people down even when you aren't?
Not really. I mean… I have off days, but I don’t think I’ve been feeling worthless or like I’m letting everyone down.
Have you felt completely unmotivated or unable to enjoy even small moments of pleasure in most activities, almost every day, since this started?

Yeah… I guess so. I kind of stopped caring about the stuff I usually like doing. Fishing, going through my records, tailgating… even checking on my home-brew. It all just started feeling like another chore.
Have you felt like nothing, not even small things, could bring you any pleasure or satisfaction most days since this started?

Yeah… most days, pretty much. The little things that usually settle me down—fishing, looking through my records, tailgating, even checking on my home-brew—just felt like chores. I didn’t really get much out of them.
Have you felt like nothing you do can bring you any enjoyment or satisfaction, even things you used to really like, most days since this started?
Yeah… like I said, the stuff I usually enjoy just doesn’t do much for me lately. Fishing, my records, tailgating, even messing with the home-brew… it all just feels like work.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or on the flip side, feeling restless or fidgety without being able to settle down?
I don’t know… not really something I’ve noticed. Maybe I’m a little slower some days, but I couldn’t say for sure.
Have you noticed that your thoughts are racing or that you can't sit still, or on the opposite end, that you're so slowed down that even simple tasks feel impossible to get through?

Yeah… more the racing thoughts part, I guess. My mind keeps jumping around—sales numbers, looking at job leads, beer recipes, old arguments—just one thing to the next. Hard to hold onto one thought for more than a few seconds.
Have you had days where you didn't feel this way, or has it been pretty much constant since it started?
It’s been pretty steady, I guess. Since that crash… maybe about three months now. I don’t get many days where it really lifts.
Have you completely lost interest in all activities, including those you used to care about, most days since this started?

Yeah… I guess so. I stopped really caring about stuff I used to do to settle myself down—fishing, looking through records, tailgating, even checking on my home-brew. It all just started feeling like chores.
